Class Key

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.client.view.tui.render.Key
public final class Key extends Object
Semantic keystroke produced by TuiTerminal.pollInput(), replacing Lanterna's KeyStroke. Only the key categories actually consumed by the TUI event layer are modelled.
